indexes.indexdef: CREATE INDEX games_explore_unclassified_idx ON public.games USING btree (id) WHERE ((explore_title_key IS NULL) OR (explore_year_suffix IS NULL) OR (explore_franchise_key IS NULL) OR (explore_developer_key IS NULL) OR (explore_publisher_key IS NULL) OR (explore_primary_safe IS NULL) OR (explore_early_access IS NULL))
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX games_pkey ON public.games USING btree (id)
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX games_slug_key ON public.games USING btree (slug)

CREATE INDEX idx_games_browse_trending_pool ON public.games USING btree (is_trending_manual DESC NULLS LAST, trending DESC NULLS LAST, current_players DESC NULLS LAST, momentum DESC NULLS LAST, verdict_score DESC NULLS LAST, review_count DESC NULLS LAST, id) WHERE (cover_image IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX idx_games_cheapshark_id ON public.games USING btree (cheapshark_id) WHERE (cheapshark_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX idx_games_community_score ON public.games USING btree (community_score DESC NULLS LAST)
CREATE INDEX idx_games_completeness_score ON public.games USING btree (completeness_score)
CREATE INDEX idx_games_confidence ON public.games USING btree (confidence DESC NULLS LAST)
CREATE INDEX idx_games_current_players ON public.games USING btree (current_players DESC NULLS LAST)
CREATE INDEX idx_games_default_browse_pool ON public.games USING btree (trending DESC NULLS LAST, verdict_score DESC NULLS LAST, release_date DESC, id) WHERE (cover_image IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX idx_games_developer ON public.games USING btree (developer) WHERE (developer <> ''::text)
CREATE INDEX idx_games_developer_trgm ON public.games USING gin (developer gin_trgm_ops)
CREATE INDEX idx_games_featured ON public.games USING btree (featured) WHERE (featured = true)
CREATE INDEX idx_games_franchise ON public.games USING btree (franchise) WHERE ((franchise IS NOT NULL) AND (franchise <> ''::text))
CREATE INDEX idx_games_genres_gin ON public.games USING gin (genres)

CREATE INDEX idx_games_homepage_recommendation_pool ON public.games USING btree (verdict_score DESC NULLS LAST, score DESC, release_date DESC) WHERE ((release_date IS NOT NULL) AND (cover_image IS NOT NULL) AND (cover_image <> ''::text) AND (score >= 75) AND (review_count >= 75) AND (confidence >= (0.4)::double precision))

CREATE INDEX idx_games_homepage_top_rated_pool ON public.games USING btree (verdict_score DESC NULLS LAST, confidence DESC NULLS LAST, score DESC, release_date DESC) WHERE ((release_date IS NOT NULL) AND (cover_image IS NOT NULL) AND (cover_image <> ''::text) AND (score >= 70) AND (review_count >= 75) AND (confidence >= (0.3)::double precision))

CREATE INDEX idx_games_homepage_trending_pool ON public.games USING btree (is_trending_manual DESC NULLS LAST, trending DESC NULLS LAST, current_players DESC NULLS LAST, momentum DESC NULLS LAST, verdict_score DESC NULLS LAST, review_count DESC NULLS LAST, score DESC) WHERE ((release_date IS NOT NULL) AND (cover_image IS NOT NULL) AND (cover_image <> ''::text) AND (score > 0))
CREATE INDEX idx_games_igdb_id ON public.games USING btree (igdb_id) WHERE (igdb_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX idx_games_is_adult ON public.games USING btree (is_adult) WHERE (is_adult = true)
CREATE INDEX idx_games_is_free ON public.games USING btree (is_free) WHERE (is_free = true)
CREATE INDEX idx_games_is_provisional ON public.games USING btree (is_provisional) WHERE (is_provisional = true)
CREATE INDEX idx_games_last_enriched ON public.games USING btree (last_enriched_at NULLS FIRST)
CREATE INDEX idx_games_manual_featured ON public.games USING btree (is_featured_manual) WHERE (is_featured_manual = true)
CREATE INDEX idx_games_manual_trending ON public.games USING btree (is_trending_manual) WHERE (is_trending_manual = true)
CREATE INDEX idx_games_momentum ON public.games USING btree (momentum DESC)
CREATE INDEX idx_games_publisher_trgm ON public.games USING gin (publisher gin_trgm_ops)
CREATE INDEX idx_games_rawg_id ON public.games USING btree (rawg_id) WHERE (rawg_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX idx_games_release_date ON public.games USING btree (release_date DESC)
CREATE INDEX idx_games_score ON public.games USING btree (score DESC)
CREATE INDEX idx_games_slug ON public.games USING btree (slug)
CREATE INDEX idx_games_steam_app_id ON public.games USING btree (steam_app_id) WHERE (steam_app_id IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX idx_games_tags_gin ON public.games USING gin (tags)
CREATE INDEX idx_games_title_trgm ON public.games USING gin (title gin_trgm_ops)
CREATE INDEX idx_games_trending ON public.games USING btree (trending) WHERE (trending = true)
CREATE INDEX idx_games_verdict_confidence ON public.games USING btree (verdict_score DESC NULLS LAST, confidence DESC NULLS LAST) WHERE (verdict_score IS NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX idx_games_verdict_score ON public.games USING btree (verdict_score DESC NULLS LAST)

Plans.Filter: (((is_provisional IS NULL) OR (NOT is_provisional)) AND (cover_image <> ''::text) AND (score > 0) AND (verdict_label <> 'COMING SOON'::text))

query: SELECT id,slug,title,cover_image,platforms,genres,tags,developer,publisher,release_date,score,verdict_score,verdict_label,confidence,review_count,monetization,steam_total_count,critic_source_count,is_free,current_players,peak_players_24h,momentum,trending,is_trending_manual,is_provisional,release_status,community_score,critic_score,score_source,user_score,rawg_metacritic,rawg_rating,steam_app_id,created_at,description FROM public.games WHERE release_date IS NOT NULL AND release_date>='2021-11-19' AND release_date<='2026-11-19' AND cover_image IS NOT NULL AND cover_image<>'' AND score>0 AND (is_provisional IS NULL OR is_provisional=false) AND verdict_label<>'COMING SOON' ORDER BY created_at DESC,id ASC LIMIT 1000
